\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\scriptsize\raggedright
\textit{Population:} TRAJECTORIES. \textit{Unit:} trajectory.
TRAJECTORIES: the repair trajectory of one base cell under one variant: iterations 0..final\_iteration, terminal status from the loop's own state ledger.
Stop statuses are trajectory facts, NOT success metrics; R09 counts trajectories that requested a repair, not successful repairs (R02 in T5/T5b).
R07 equals the R06 stopped\_budget share and R08 the R06 stopped\_analysis\_incomplete share (identical counts, checked); both are shown under their own metric ids.
R09 repaired\_share: meaning = trajectories that requested at least one repair (final\_iteration \textgreater{}= 1); numerator = trajectories; denominator = trajectories; unit = trajectory.
IC6: static\_feedback repair triggers are dominated by clang-tidy bugprone findings and, on MPI, by low-confidence hints (design document: no trustworthy static MPI tool exists); static\_feedback results measure this frozen blocking-set configuration, not static analysis in general.
\textit{Definitions} (methodology; full text in the JSON form of this table): R06 stop\_status\_distribution; R07 budget\_exhaustion\_rate; R08 analysis\_incomplete\_stop\_rate; R10 iterations\_used.\par
\textsuperscript{a}~pilot: pilot\_002 / Pilotexperiment (12 benchmarks x 3 execution models x 11 models, 1 sample per prompt); pilot block has 12 clusters: percentile intervals are approximate; flagged in every pilot table\par
\textsuperscript{c}~terminal statuses with 0 trajectories in every row (not shown): repair\_unusable, stopped\_baseline\_incompatible, stopped\_api\_exhausted\par
\end{minipage}
